sources.claim_used: A smooth morphism is universally open.
A proper morphism has closed image.
A closed immersion is proper, so the cusp counterexample already satisfies properness.

elementary_proof_boundary: The cusp tangent calculation itself is direct: the defining equation y^2-x^3 has zero differential at the origin, so the Zariski tangent space is the full ambient plane, while the closed immersion has proper image equal only to the cusp.
source_nonclaims: The Stacks references do not construct an algebraic-witness incidence for an arbitrary rational Hodge class.
The references do not prove initial algebraicity, exact signed-rational class preservation, formal lifting, algebraization, monodromy, or global continuation.
